cards.card_text: The Babylonians The Egyptians The Persians
cards.verse_text: wearing belts on their waists and flowing turbans on their heads; all of them looked like officers of the Babylonians in Chaldea, the land of their birth.
cards.snippet: …turbans on their heads; all of them looked like officers of the Babylonians in Chaldea, the land of their birth.

cards.card_text: So the Babylonians come to her, and they defile her.
cards.verse_text: Then the Babylonians came to her, to the bed of love, and in their lust they defiled her.
cards.snippet: Then the Babylonians came to her, to the bed of love, and in their lust…

cards.card_text: Once the Babylonians have defiled her, how does Oholibah feel about them?
cards.verse_text: Then the Babylonians came to her, to the bed of love, and in their lust they defiled her.
cards.snippet: Then the Babylonians came to her, to the bed of love, and in their lust…

cards.card_text: God names who's coming: the Babylonians, all the Chaldeans, the men of Pekod, Shoa and Koa, and all the Assyrians with them.
cards.verse_text: the Babylonians and all the Chaldeans, the men of Pekod, Shoa, and Koa, and all the Assyrians with them—all desirable young men, governors and commanders, officers and men of renown, mounted on horses.
